text:
Type: woven throw cushion
Use: accent comfort on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, traditional, contemporary
Materials: woven linen-look fabric with fine windowpane check, whipstitched edge
Colors: light warm grey, faint rust and cream check lines, white stitching
Shape: square, subtle grid pattern, slub texture, contrast whipstitch around the edge, medium size
Feel: soft, cozy, understated
Goes with: grey or beige sofas, cream throws, natural wood; farmhouse or traditional living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Whipstitch Edge Decorative Throw Pillow, 18" x 18", Light Grey with White Whipstitch
product.description: Look closely: This seemingly solid light grey pillow actually has a subtle plaid of burnt siena thread. Whip-stitching around the edges gives it a clean, crisp look. This pillow is versatile enough to blend with any style bedding. 18" x 18" 75% Polyester, 15% Cotton, 10% Lycra Polyester fiber-filled insert Made in India Brush, vacuum or spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
